limitations: AI terminology audit, not native/domain certification.
English reference is 1号 only; 2号-specific terms without reference support retained.
Reference index and body inventory checked; PDF20,73,75 rendered and visually inspected. Other mapped terminology pages text-inspected only.
No source facts, numbers, option order, sourceHash, or review flags changed.
Medically broader heat illness is normalized only where it is the Japanese textbook 熱中症 term.
殺菌 microbial inactivation and 加熱殺菌 heat-treatment paraphrases retained where replacing with sterilization could overstate the Japanese safety claim.
Core/center and occupational/labor terminology variants are standardization, not claims that former terms are scientifically wrong.
No source redistribution or repo/Git edits.
This is a terminology-directed string scan, not a complete independent retranslation of every field; unsupported 2号-specific vocabulary is retained.

Reference PDF43 conflates verification/validation labels; canonical 2026 distinction 妥当性確認 validation versus 検証 verification is retained. Date changes are bound to matching Japanese 消費期限 fields, excluding 使用期限 and mixed passages except its exact definition.

actualScope.source: English 2024 PDF pp20,35,43,70–75,77 extracted and rendered; rendered contact sheet viewed. Each terminology family compared against its source glossary/body label.
actualScope.canonical: Direct Japanese comparison for 5S lesson food-1-009, three date concepts lesson food-1-019 and q100/q167/q345, level2 q188 and q191; additional first-level management/remedial lesson source already examined during ID audit. Other families assessed by named Japanese term and changed English spans, not full retranslation.
actualScope.validation: 2024 PDF43 calls principle6 validation; no proposed verification/validation replacement, so 2026 Japanese distinction remains intact.

limitations: AI peer terminology review, not native/domain or clinical certification.
Contact sheet verifies labels and source page extraction; not a full visual review of every source page.
